title: "Read Distribution and Taxonomy Analysis"
output: html_document

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(gt)
library(here)
library(pavian)
theme_set(theme_bw())
# child ids under oomycota: 4762
oomycete.ids <- read_lines(here('data', 'oomycete_taxids.txt'))
```

# Read distribution of the PacBio HIFI reads

```{r echo=FALSE}
files <- list.files('~/project_data/downy/k2_pfp',
                    full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE, pattern = '.kraken$')
df <- map_dfr(files, function(file) {
  data <- fread(file, drop = 5, showProgress = FALSE)
  colnames(data) <- c('status', 'id', 'tax', 'length')
  data <- data %>% mutate(file = str_remove(basename(file), '.kraken'))
}) %>% mutate(is.oomycota = (tax %in% oomycete.ids))

# rename samples
df$Isolate <- df$file |> 
  str_replace('p_effusa', 'P. effusa (UA202013)') |> 
  str_replace("Quesada_SQIIe_MSU1", "P. cubensis (MSU1)") |> 
  str_replace("Quesada_SQIIe_Phumuli", "P. humuli (Phumuli)") |> 
  str_replace("Quesada_SQIIe_SC1982", "P. cubensis (SC1982)")
df$Isolate <- factor(df$Isolate, levels = c("P. cubensis (MSU1)",
                                            "P. cubensis (SC1982)",
                                            "P. humuli (Phumuli)",
                                            'P. effusa (UA202013)'))
read.dist <- ggplot(df) +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = length, fill = is.oomycota), binwidth = 1000) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  facet_wrap(~Isolate, ncol = 1, scales = 'free_y')
read.dist
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
files <- list.files('~/project_data/downy/k2_pfp',
                    full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE, pattern = '.kreport$')
df.rpt <- map_dfr(files, function(file) {
  read_report2(file, add_taxRank_columns = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(file = str_remove(basename(file), '.kreport'))})

# rename samples
df.rpt$Isolate <- df.rpt$file |> 
  str_replace('p_effusa', 'P. effusa (UA202013)') |> 
  str_replace("Quesada_SQIIe_MSU1", "P. cubensis (MSU1)") |> 
  str_replace("Quesada_SQIIe_Phumuli", "P. humuli (Phumuli)") |> 
  str_replace("Quesada_SQIIe_SC1982", "P. cubensis (SC1982)")
df.rpt$Isolate <- factor(df.rpt$Isolate, levels = c("P. cubensis (MSU1)",
                                                    "P. cubensis (SC1982)",
                                                    "P. humuli (Phumuli)",
                                                    'P. effusa (UA202013)'))
```


```{r echo=FALSE}
df.rpt |> 
  group_by(Isolate) |> 
  filter(name == "p_Oomycota") |> 
  select(percentage, cladeReads, name, Isolate)
```


```{r}
df.rpt |> 
  group_by(Isolate) |> 
  filter(name == "g_Homo") |> 
  select(percentage, cladeReads, name, Isolate)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
df.rpt |> 
  group_by(Isolate) |> 
  filter(name %in% c("f_Cannabaceae", "f_Cucurbitaceae", "f_Amaranthaceae")) |> 
  select(percentage, cladeReads, name, Isolate) |> 
  gt()
```


```{r}
tax.bar <- df.rpt |> 
  group_by(Isolate) |> 
  filter(taxRank %in% c('U', 'P')) |> 
  mutate(taxon = if_else(percentage <= 5, 'other', name)) |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(aes(x = Isolate, y = percentage, fill = taxon), position = 'fill', stat = 'identity')+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))
tax.bar
```

```{r}
df.rpt |> 
  filter(!(taxID %in% oomycete.ids), P == 'p_Pseudomonadota', taxRank == 'G') |> 
  group_by(Isolate) |> 
  arrange(desc(percentage)) |> 
  slice_head(n = 10) |> 
  gt()
```
